rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no explicit opt-out (feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty, no tests-added label), and the change is clearly user-facing: it rewrites alert list tabs, page headers, tables, refresh buttons, selects, and visual tokens across web/src.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The alert list page's tab control was migrated from AppTabs to OToggleGroup/OToggleGroupItem (changing data-test attributes), page headers gained subtitles and tabs-below, and shared core components (OTable, ORefreshButton, OSelect, OTag) gained new props, tooltips, and empty states — all user-visible behavior that needs verification.
rationale.area: Alerts is the primary area. The most concrete behavioral change is the AlertList tab migration plus the AlertLibrary header changes, and the E2E page object tests/ui-testing/pages/alertsPages/alertsPage.js was updated in the same diff. Note the change is cross-cutting and also touches DatabaseMonitoring and SLO views.
rationale.group: The Alerts matrix shard (actual_folder Alerts) already exists in the playwright matrix and is the closest fit for the alert list/library pages this change rewrites.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/** are changed in the diff. The only test-file changes are Vitest unit specs (web/src/**/*.spec.ts) and the Alerts page-object helper tests/ui-testing/pages/alertsPages/alertsPage.js, neither of which counts as E2E spec coverage — so no E2E specs in the diff.
